exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Kronk's day is a musical montage of his two lives, chef and villain's henchman. Then watch the finale: Kronk's father learns what his son actually is, and the film's message lands without preaching.

name: The Tigger Movie (2000)
teaser: The first Winnie the Pooh theatrical feature since 1977 — and the story of Tigger's search for his family. The film's 'Your Heart Will Lead You Home' song, written by Kenny Loggins, is the emotional climax.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Hundred Acre Wood is drawn in the classic storybook style, and the animation is a full step up from TV. Then watch the flood scene: the film's emotional peak, where the friends build a raft to find Tigger's family.

name: Piglet's Big Movie (2003)
teaser: The smallest character gets the whole film — Piglet saves his friends using the scrapbook of memories they never knew he kept. It's a movie about being the quiet one, and its animation uses the scrapbook pages as cutaways into memory.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the scrapbook sequences — Piglet's memories are drawn in a different, softer style, like pages turning. Then watch the finale: the smallest hero does the biggest rescue, and the film's message is that size isn't character.

name: Pooh's Heffalump Movie (2005)
teaser: The Hundred Acre Wood meets a heffalump — and the friends learn the creature they fear is just a child like them. The film's friendship between Roo and Lumpy is its heart, and its 'Little Brother' song is the emotional peak.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the heffalump hunt is a full comedy set piece, with each friend imagining the monster differently. Then watch the finale: Roo's friendship with Lumpy is the film's real point, a lesson in fear and understanding.

name: Mickey's Christmas Carol (1983)
teaser: The first Mickey Mouse theatrical release in 30 years — a 25-minute version of Dickens with Mickey as Bob Cratchit and Scrooge McDuck as Ebenezer. It was the first animated film to use the 'Computer Animation Production System' that later defined Disney's digital era.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the ghost sequences — the animation blends the classic Mickey design with Dickensian fog and candlelight. Then watch the finale: Scrooge McDuck's redemption is played with full Disney theatrical energy.

name: Mickey's Twice Upon a Christmas (2004)
teaser: The first Mickey Mouse feature in computer animation — five holiday stories, from Donald's ice hockey game to Daisy's ice show. Its 'Christmas in the House of Mouse' segment is a full song-and-dance finale.

exploreAction.targetName: Mickey's Twice Upon a Christmas (2004) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the Donald segment — his ice hockey game is the film's best set piece, with full slapstick physics. Then watch the finale: the whole gang gathers for a Christmas number that closes the film.

name: Mickey, Donald, Goofy: The Three Musketeers (2004)
teaser: The trio as Dumas's musketeers — Donald as the swashbuckling hero, Goofy as his loyal friend, Mickey as the pawn who saves the day. It's a musical adventure with a full original score, including 'Chains of Love' and the finale's 'Sweet Wings of Love'.

exploreAction.targetName: Mickey, Donald, Goofy: The Three Musketeers (2004) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the sword-fight training — the animation blends slapstick with real swashbuckling choreography. Then watch the finale: the trio's teamwork against the villain is a full action set piece with a musical number.

name: Planes (2013)
teaser: The Cars universe takes flight — Dusty, a crop duster with a fear of heights, enters a world race. It was originally planned as a direct-to-video title before being upgraded to theatrical, and its voice cast includes racing legend Dale Earnhardt Jr.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Dusty's barnstorming routine is a full aviation set piece, and the animation team consulted real pilots. Then watch the world race: every leg of the course has its own landscape, from the Himalayas to the Amazon.

name: Planes: Fire & Rescue (2014)
teaser: The sequel about Dusty's new life as a firefighter — a midair firefighting team takes on a wildfire at Piston Peak. The film's fire scenes were a technical first for the Cars universe, with full flame simulation.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the fire sequences — the flames are simulated with real fire physics, and the smoke is used as a storytelling device. Then watch the finale: the rescue at the burning lodge is the film's emotional peak.

name: Antz (1998)
teaser: DreamWorks' first animated feature — and the first big-studio CGI film to answer Pixar's Toy Story. The voice cast (Woody Allen, Sharon Stone, Gene Hackman) was the starriest animation had ever seen, and the colony's worker-vs-queen politics made it unusually adult for a kids' film.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the camera rides on a falling leaf with the ant colony singing, a technical showpiece for 1998. Then watch the final battle at the picnic: the two armies fight over a dropped sandwich, and the film's themes of individuality land through it.

name: The Prince of Egypt (1998)
teaser: DreamWorks' prestige musical about Moses — with traditional animation at its grandest, from the burning bush to the parting of the Red Sea. The 'When You Believe' duet won the Oscar for Best Original Song, and the filmmakers consulted biblical scholars to get the story right.
byline: Brenda Chapman, Simon Wells & Steve Hickner

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the parting of the Red Sea — the single most expensive animated sequence ever made at the time, with thousands of gallons of simulated water. Then watch the opening 'Deliver Us' sequence: the enslaved Hebrews are shown in vast, oppressive wide shots.

name: The Road to El Dorado (2000)
teaser: Two con artists stumble into the legendary city of gold and get mistaken for gods. The swashbuckling buddy comedy underperformed at the box office but became a cult favorite for its whip-smart dialogue and Elton John's score.

exploreAction.targetName: The Road to El Dorado (2000) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Tulio and Miguel win a map in a dice game and flee on horseback, a chase that sets the whole tone. Then watch the finale: the pair choose friendship over gold, and the city's secret of the stone boat is revealed.

name: Joseph: King of Dreams (2000)
teaser: The direct-to-video prequel to The Prince of Egypt, telling Joseph's story from his coat of many colors to his rise in Egypt. It reunited the voice of Moses' father and used the same epic musical style.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the dreams that set the story in motion are rendered as swirling color. Then watch the finale: Joseph reveals himself to his brothers, and the film turns forgiveness into its theme.

name: Shrek the Third (2007)
teaser: Shrek is next in line for the throne and recruits Arthur — a nerdy teenager at Worcestershire Academy — to take the crown instead. The film's fairy-tale-royalty satire is at its sharpest in the school for princes.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Fiona's pregnancy news throws Shrek into a panic, and the film's comedy of reluctant royalty begins. Then watch Artie's arc: the 'you can do anything' speech to the villains is the film's heart.

name: Shrek Forever After (2010)
teaser: The fourth Shrek film sends him into a deal with Rumpelstiltskin that erases his existence — a 'what if' story in a world where Fiona leads an ogre resistance. It was marketed as the finale of the saga.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Shrek's midlife crisis sets up the deal with Rumpelstiltskin. Then watch the finale: Shrek chooses Fiona and the ogre family over his freedom, restoring the timeline with a kiss.

name: Puss in Boots (2011)
teaser: The swashbuckling feline's solo origin story — a heist comedy where Puss, Humpty Dumpty and Kitty Softpaws try to steal magic beans. It was the highest-grossing non-Shrek DreamWorks film at the time.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Puss' arrival in town is a full spaghetti-western homage with guitar riffs. Then watch the final heist: the beanstalk grows into a castle, and the team's betrayal and redemption play out in the clouds.

name: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron (2002)
teaser: A wild mustang's journey across the American frontier, told without animal dialogue — only narration from Matt Damon and Hans Zimmer's score. The animation team studied real horses for months to capture their movement.

exploreAction.targetName: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron (2002) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Spirit's birth and first gallop across the plains is a wordless set piece. Then watch the finale: Spirit refuses to be broken, and the film's freedom theme peaks as he leaps the canyon.

name: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas (2003)
teaser: DreamWorks' last traditional-animation feature — Sinbad must steal the Book of Peace to save his friend Proteus from death. Brad Pitt voiced Sinbad, and the film blended hand-drawn characters with early CGI environments.

exploreAction.targetName: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas (2003) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Sinbad's pirate crew raids a temple, and the chase through the collapsing temple sets the pace. Then watch the finale: Sinbad chooses honor over freedom, and Eris' trick is undone.

name: Chicken Run (2000)
teaser: Aardman's first feature — a stop-motion parody of The Great Escape set in a chicken farm where the hens plan a breakout before they become pies. It remains the highest-grossing stop-motion film ever.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the chickens' escape attempts montage is a comedy of failed engineering, from knitting to catapults. Then watch the finale: the rooster Rocky's secret is revealed, and the plane escape sequence launches.

name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit (2005)
teaser: The cheese-loving inventor and his dog turn pest controllers and face a giant vegetable-munching were-rabbit. It won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature — Aardman's first feature win.

exploreAction.targetName: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit (2005) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Wallace's anti-pesto inventions go hilariously wrong in the vegetable contest setup. Then watch the finale: the were-rabbit's identity is revealed in the moonlit garden, and Gromit saves the day with a brain-blast.

name: Madagascar (2005)
teaser: Four Central Park Zoo animals shipwreck on the island of Madagascar and meet the lemur king Julien. The film's 'I Like to Move It' dance scene became one of animation's most memed moments.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the penguins' escape from the zoo sets up the whole plot with deadpan precision. Then watch the finale: Alex's 'New York, New York' moment and the lemurs' party close the film.

name: Madagascar: Escape 2 Africa (2008)
teaser: The animals crash-land in Africa and meet their own species — Alex finds his parents, and the film becomes a family reunion comedy. The waterhole scene, where the penguins take over, is a fan favorite.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the plane crash is a full action sequence with the penguins 'flying' the wreck. Then watch the finale: Alex's mating dance and the herd's stand against the hunters close the story.

name: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted (2012)
teaser: The gang joins a struggling European circus to escape animal control. The film's 3D circus finale was praised as some of the best animated spectacle of its year.
byline: Eric Darnell, Tom McGrath & Conrad Vernon

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the animals flee Monte Carlo, and the chase through the casino is a full action set piece. Then watch the finale: the circus act with the tigers and the fire is the film's showstopper.

name: Penguins of Madagascar (2014)
teaser: Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private go up against the villainous octopus Dr. Octavius Brine. The film's secret agent parody gave the penguins their own spy movie.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the penguins' 'covert' rescue of a chimp is a parody of every heist movie. Then watch the finale: Private's solo move saves the team, and the film's 'everyone has a role' theme lands.

name: Over the Hedge (2006)
teaser: Forest animals wake from hibernation to find a suburban hedge — and RJ the raccoon leads them on a raid of the humans' food. Bruce Willis and Steve Carell headlined, and the film satirized consumer culture.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — RJ's run-in with a bear sets up his debt plot. Then watch the finale: the animals' heist of the pantry is a full comedy caper with a lawnmower chase.

name: Flushed Away (2006)
teaser: Aardman's first CGI film — a pampered pet mouse flushed down a toilet into the sewers of 'Ratropolis.' It blended Aardman's character comedy with digital animation.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Roddy's flush down the toilet is a full journey sequence through the pipes. Then watch the finale: the wave chase through the sewers closes the adventure.

name: Bee Movie (2007)
teaser: Jerry Seinfeld's animated bee — a lawyer bee who sues humans for stealing honey. The film's courtroom comedy and rapid-fire bee jokes made it a pop-culture fixture.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Barry's graduation and the 'bees work all day' montage set up the world. Then watch the finale: the courtroom verdict and the bees' return to nature close the story.

name: Kung Fu Panda (2008)
teaser: A clumsy panda becomes the Dragon Warrior and must master kung fu to stop the villain Tai Lung. The film's animation team studied real kung fu and used DreamWorks' most detailed fight choreography to date.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the hand-drawn dream sequence sets the tone with 2D flourishes. Then watch the finale: Po's 'secret ingredient' realization and his fight with Tai Lung in the bridge sequence.

name: Kung Fu Panda 2 (2011)
teaser: Po discovers his past — he was adopted after his village was destroyed by Lord Shen's cannon. It was the first sequel directed entirely by a woman in DreamWorks history.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the flashback to Po's origins is drawn in a stylized 2D style. Then watch the finale: Po's inner peace deflects Shen's cannons in the harbor battle.

name: Kung Fu Panda 3 (2016)
teaser: Po reunites with his biological father and must train a village of pandas to fight Kai, a chi-stealing bull. It was the first co-production between DreamWorks and China's Oriental DreamWorks.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Kai's return from the spirit realm is rendered in a unique style of floating jade. Then watch the finale: Po teaches the pandas chi, and the village becomes an army.

name: Monsters vs. Aliens (2009)
teaser: A woman zapped by a meteor grows to 49 feet and is recruited into a government monster team to fight a giant alien robot. It was the first DreamWorks film shot in Dolby 3D.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Susan's wedding day goes wrong when the meteor hits, and her growth is played as a comedy set piece. Then watch the finale: the monster team's battle against Gallaxhar's robot.

name: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World (2019)
teaser: The trilogy finale — Hiccup and Toothless find a hidden dragon world, and Toothless falls for a light fury. It was the rare threequel that critics called the best of its trilogy.

exploreAction.targetName: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World (2019) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the dragon rescue raid is a full flight sequence. Then watch the finale: Toothless' choice between the light fury and Hiccup, and the bittersweet goodbye that closes the saga.

name: Trolls (2016)
teaser: Happy-go-lucky trolls must rescue their friends from the Bergens, who eat trolls to feel happiness. The film's glitter-bomb aesthetic and Justin Timberlake's 'Can't Stop the Feeling' made it a sensation.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the trolls' hug-a-thon and party montage establish the world. Then watch the finale: Poppy and Branch's journey home and the big dance-off with the Bergens.

name: Trolls World Tour (2020)
teaser: Poppy and Branch discover the trolls are divided into six music tribes — and a hard-rock queen wants to silence them all. The film's music-tribe concept turned genres into characters.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the six music tribes are introduced with their own visual styles. Then watch the finale: the dance battle of the genres and the message that music unites.

name: Trolls Band Together (2023)
teaser: Branch's boy-band past resurfaces when his brother Floyd is kidnapped. The film's 90s boy-band parody — BroZone — got an original soundtrack from the real NSYNC.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the BroZone reunion is staged as a boy-band reunion special. Then watch the finale: the brothers' 'Perfect Family Harmony' performance frees Floyd.

name: The Croods (2013)
teaser: A prehistoric family must leave their cave for the first time when an earthquake destroys their home. The film's colorful 'new world' design came from the same team behind How to Train Your Dragon.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the cave-family's survival rules montage sets up their world. Then watch the finale: the family's leap across the chasm, and Guy's 'follow the sun' promise.

name: The Croods: A New Age (2020)
teaser: The Croods meet a sophisticated family in a walled paradise — and must decide between comfort and their own identity. The film's 'betterman' satire is aimed squarely at suburban living.

exploreAction.targetName: The Croods: A New Age (2020) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Croods' journey leads them to the Betterman farm, and the two families' cultures clash. Then watch the finale: the joint rescue of the 'thunder brothers' and the families' compromise.

name: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie (2017)
teaser: Two prankster kids hypnotize their principal into believing he's a superhero in his underwear. The film's flip-o-rama sequences paid tribute to Dav Pilkey's original books.

exploreAction.targetName: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie (2017) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — George and Harold's prank history is told in flip-book style. Then watch the finale: the principal-as-Captain-Underpants fights Professor Poopypants' robot.

name: Abominable (2019)
teaser: A teenage girl and her friends help a young Yeti named Everest return home across China. The film was the first DreamWorks feature set in China, with landscapes modeled on real places.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Everest's escape from the lab and his meeting with Yi in the courtyard. Then watch the finale: Everest's reunion with his family, and the bloom of the magical flowers.

name: Home (2015)
teaser: A friendly alien fugitive and a brave girl team up to find her mother after the alien race accidentally relocates humanity. Rihanna voiced Tip and contributed the hit single 'Towards the Sun.'

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Boov's relocation of humanity is played as a comedy of errors. Then watch the finale: Oh and Tip's road trip ends with the reunification of families.

name: The Boss Baby (2017)
teaser: A baby in a business suit and his older brother must foil a plot by puppy corporation Puppy Co. The film's 'baby as corporate executive' premise earned an Oscar nomination.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the 'Boss Baby' arrival montage sets up the premise with full absurdity. Then watch the finale: Tim and Boss Baby's mission against Puppy Co. and their brotherly bond.

name: The Boss Baby: Family Business (2021)
teaser: The Templeton brothers are adults when a new Boss Baby recruits them for a mission at Acorn Baby Corp. The film's 'baby powers' concept — adults becoming babies — drives the comedy.

exploreAction.targetName: The Boss Baby: Family Business (2021) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Tim's grown-up family life and Ted's CEO routine establish the rift. Then watch the finale: the brothers' mission in the baby world restores their bond.

name: Turbo (2013)
teaser: A garden snail dreams of speed and gets his wish when a freak accident gives him super-racing powers. The film's Indy 500 climax featured a real partnership with the race.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Turbo's slow-motion world view makes a garden hose a flood. Then watch the finale: Turbo's Indy 500 run, where the whole snail community cheers him on.

name: Rise of the Guardians (2012)
teaser: Santa, the Easter Bunny, the Tooth Fairy and the Sandman must stop the Boogeyman Pitch from erasing childhood belief. The film's visual design by Guillermo del Toro collaborators gave it a distinctive dark sheen.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Jack Frost's backstory is revealed in a monochrome flashback. Then watch the finale: the guardians' stand against Pitch at the North Pole, and Jack's belief in himself.

name: Mr. Peabody & Sherman (2014)
teaser: A genius dog and his adopted boy travel time in the WABAC machine. The film was based on the classic 1960s Rocky and Bullwinkle segments.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Peabody's time-travel montage through history sets up the world. Then watch the finale: the duo must repair the space-time continuum after Sherman's misadventures.

name: Megamind (2010)
teaser: A supervillain finally defeats his hero — and is bored without a rival, so he creates a new one. The film's supervillain comedy starred Will Ferrell and was praised for its twist on the genre.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Megamind's origin story is told in a self-narrated montage. Then watch the finale: Megamind must become a hero for real when his creation turns evil.

name: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken (2023)
teaser: A shy teen discovers she's a kraken — heir to a sea-monster lineage that guards the ocean from mermaids. The film's 'teen discovers secret identity' premise riffed on the Little Mermaid myth.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Ruby's high school life hides her secret, and her crush on the skateboarder sets up the plot. Then watch the finale: Ruby embraces her kraken powers to save the ocean.

name: Dog Man (2025)
teaser: The Captain Underpants universe spin-off — a police dog and his cop are fused into one crime-fighting half-dog, half-man. The film adapted Dav Pilkey's mega-selling graphic novels.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the 'origin' of Dog Man is staged as a comedic accident. Then watch the finale: Dog Man and Petey the cat's rivalry turns into friendship.

name: Spirit Untamed (2021)
teaser: A wild girl and a wild horse bond in the American frontier — a reimagining of the Spirit story for a new generation. The film added Lucky Prescott as its lead.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Lucky's arrival in Miradero and her first meeting with Spirit. Then watch the finale: Lucky rides Spirit to save the wild horses from the wranglers.

name: Despicable Me 2 (2013)
teaser: Gru is recruited by the Anti-Villain League to stop a new villain — while raising three girls and falling for agent Lucy. It grossed over $970 million worldwide, making it the highest-grossing animated film of 2013.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Gru's attempts at a normal family life at a birthday party. Then watch the finale: Gru's fight at the mall and Lucy's proposal, with the Minions' wedding cameo.

name: Despicable Me 3 (2017)
teaser: Gru discovers he has a twin brother, Dru, and meets the 80s-obsessed villain Balthazar Bratt. The film's Bratt character was voiced by Trey Parker, parodying 80s cartoon villains.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Bratt's 'Evil Bratt' dance number is a full 80s-montage parody. Then watch the finale: the brothers' joint heist to save Lucy and the girls.

name: Despicable Me 4 (2024)
teaser: Gru faces his old schoolmate Maxime Le Mal — and the family must hide in a witness-protection town. The film introduced Gru Jr., a baby who despises his father.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Minions' new Mega Minions forms are introduced at the Anti-Villain League. Then watch the finale: Gru's showdown with Maxime at the school talent show.

name: Minions (2015)
teaser: The origin story of the yellow pill-shaped minions, from single-celled organisms to servants of villain after villain. It was the second highest-grossing animated film of all time at release.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the minions' evolutionary history is a fast-cut comedy montage through the ages. Then watch the finale: Kevin, Stuart and Bob's mission to serve Scarlet Overkill.

name: Minions: The Rise of Gru (2022)
teaser: In 1970s San Francisco, a young Gru dreams of joining the Vicious 6 — and the minions help him on his first heist. The film's 70s soundtrack and Kung Fu Chow style fight scenes won it over.

exploreAction.targetName: Minions: The Rise of Gru (2022) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — young Gru's interview with the Vicious 6 goes wrong in classic style. Then watch the finale: Gru's heist of the Zodiac Stone with his minion crew.

name: Sing (2016)
teaser: A koala theater owner stages a singing competition to save his theater. The film's ensemble voice cast — Matthew McConaughey, Reese Witherspoon, Scarlett Johansson — sang all their own parts.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Buster Moon's failed sales pitch and the contest poster's typo ('a billion dollars') set up the plot. Then watch the finale: the rebuilt theater's opening night concert.

name: Sing 2 (2021)
teaser: Buster Moon's troupe stages a grand show in the entertainment capital, Redshore City — with a reclusive rock star voiced by Bono. The film's 'Out of This World' finale is its centerpiece.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the troupe's disastrous audition in Redshore City sets the stakes. Then watch the finale: the 'Out of This World' performance with Clay Calloway on stage.

name: The Secret Life of Pets (2016)
teaser: What do pets do when their owners leave? The film's answer — a party, a rebellion and an adventure through New York — made it a box office phenomenon.

exploreAction.targetName: The Secret Life of Pets (2016) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the pets' morning routine montage reveals their secret lives. Then watch the finale: Max and Duke's chase with the gang through the city.

name: The Secret Life of Pets 2 (2019)
teaser: Max gains a new human (and a toddler) and must face his fears, while Snowball becomes a superhero. The film's farm storyline sent Max and Duke to the country.

exploreAction.targetName: The Secret Life of Pets 2 (2019) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Max's anxiety about the toddler Liam is played as comedy. Then watch the finale: Snowball's superhero rescue of the tiger cub from the circus.

name: Hop (2011)
teaser: The Easter Bunny's son E.B. runs away to Hollywood and meets a slacker who accidentally kills the real Easter Bunny. The film blended live action with CGI characters.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — E.B.'s drumming audition and his escape from Easter Island. Then watch the finale: E.B. and Fred's return to Easter Island to save Easter.

name: The Lorax (2012)
teaser: A boy searches for the fabled Lorax to win the heart of his crush in a plastic world without trees. The film adapted Dr. Seuss' environmental fable with an ecological message.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Once-ler's story of chopping the Truffula trees is told in flashback. Then watch the finale: the boy's return of the Truffula seed and the promise of a greener future.

name: The Grinch (2018)
teaser: The Dr. Seuss classic — a green grouch plots to steal Christmas from Whoville. Benedict Cumberbatch voiced the Grinch in this retelling, which added a backstory for his hatred of the holiday.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Grinch's cavern home and his surveillance of Whoville establish the world. Then watch the finale: the Grinch's heart grows three sizes at the Whos' sing-along.

name: Migration (2023)
teaser: A family of mallards decides to migrate south for the first time — a comedy about leaving the safe pond. The film came from the director of Ernest & Celestine, with a voice cast including Kumail Nanjiani and Awkwafina.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Mallard family's debate about migration vs. staying on the pond. Then watch the finale: the family's flight through New York and their choice to keep exploring.

name: Ice Age (2002)
teaser: A mammoth, a sloth and a saber-toothed tiger form an unlikely trio to return a human baby to its tribe. It was the first feature from Blue Sky Studios, founded by former Disney animators.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the animated 'Scrat' short that opens the film, a silent comedy of an acorn. Then watch the finale: the herd's journey through the ice canyon and Manny's acceptance of the baby.

name: Ice Age: The Meltdown (2006)
teaser: The herd must race to higher ground as the ice age melts. The film's flood escape sequences pushed Blue Sky's water simulation technology.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Scrat's attempt to crack the ice into the subterranean world. Then watch the finale: the herd's rescue from the flood and Manny's discovery of his own kind.

name: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs (2009)
teaser: The herd journeys into an underground dinosaur world to rescue Sid, who adopted three dino eggs. The film's 'dino world' was Blue Sky's most elaborate environment yet.

exploreAction.targetName: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs (2009) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Sid's failed attempts to be a parent to the eggs. Then watch the finale: the herd's escape from the dinosaur world with the T-Rex mother in pursuit.

name: Ice Age: Continental Drift (2012)
teaser: Manny, Diego and Sid are separated from the herd on an iceberg and meet a pirate crew. The film's pirate plot added a whole seafaring cast.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the continental split separates the herd, and the friends end up adrift. Then watch the finale: the herd's reunion after the pirate battle.

name: Ice Age: Collision Course (2016)
teaser: Scrat's acorn-chasing sends an asteroid toward Earth, and the herd must redirect it. The film's space plot gave Scrat his wildest adventure yet.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Scrat's launch into space aboard a UFO sets the plot in motion. Then watch the finale: the herd's plan to bounce the asteroid away with crystals.

name: Robots (2005)
teaser: A young robot inventor moves to Robot City to meet his idol — and finds a corrupt corporate scheme. The film's dense mechanical world was a showcase for Blue Sky's rendering.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Rodney's arrival in Robot City, a vast metropolis of chrome. Then watch the finale: Rodney's invention saves the town and exposes Bigweld's betrayal.

name: Rio (2011)
teaser: A domesticated macaw named Blu travels to Rio de Janeiro to save his species. The film's carnival finale was animated with a live samba troupe's choreography.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Blu's life as a caged pet in Minnesota and his trip to Rio. Then watch the finale: the carnival flight, with Blu flying for the first time to save Jewel.

name: Rio 2 (2014)
teaser: Blu and Jewel find their way to the Amazon — and Jewel's family, who live wild. The film's Amazon setting was rendered with real rainforest research.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the family's journey to the Amazon and the reunion with Jewel's parents. Then watch the finale: the two flocks' battle against the loggers and the 'poison frog' dance.

name: Epic (2013)
teaser: A teenager shrinks into a secret forest world at war between leafmen and rot. The film's forest was rendered at microscopic scale with real botanical research.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — MK's discovery of the forest world and her transformation into a leafman. Then watch the finale: the leafmen's battle against Mandrake's rot army.

name: The Peanuts Movie (2015)
teaser: Charlie Brown gets a new neighbor, the Little Red-Haired Girl, and tries to win her over — with Snoopy's flying-ace fantasy woven in. The film used computer animation rendered to look like hand-drawn Peanuts.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Charlie Brown's walk to school and his first glimpse of the Little Red-Haired Girl. Then watch the finale: Snoopy's airborne victory and Charlie Brown's dance at the party.

name: Ferdinand (2017)
teaser: A gentle bull who loves flowers is mistaken for a fighting bull and taken to the bullring. The film adapted Munro Leaf's 1936 children's classic, with John Cena voicing Ferdinand.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — young Ferdinand's refusal to fight and his escape from the bull academy. Then watch the finale: Ferdinand's refusal to fight in the ring, choosing peace over violence.

name: Horton Hears a Who! (2008)
teaser: An elephant hears a speck of dust carrying an entire city — the Whos — and must protect it. Jim Carrey voiced Horton in this Dr. Seuss adaptation.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Horton's discovery of the speck and the voice of the Mayor of Whoville. Then watch the finale: Horton's 'a person's a person, no matter how small' speech.

name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
teaser: A wacky inventor builds a machine that makes food rain from the sky — until it goes haywire. The Lord & Miller comedy launched one of Sony's biggest franchises.

exploreAction.targetName: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs (2009) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Flint's failed inventions montage sets up the comedy. Then watch the finale: the food tornado climax and Flint's choice to stop the machine.

name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2 (2013)
teaser: The island of Swallow Falls becomes home to living food creatures. The film's 'foodimals' — like the tacodile — became instant fan favorites.

exploreAction.targetName: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2 (2013) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the reveal that the food machine created a living food ecosystem. Then watch the finale: the 'flintroid' confrontation and the foodimals' rescue.

name: Hotel Transylvania (2012)
teaser: Dracula runs a luxury resort for monsters, and a human stumbles in — and falls for his daughter. Genndy Tartakovsky's first feature turned the monster family into comedy gold.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Dracula's lullaby backstory for Mavis. Then watch the finale: Johnny's 'human' reveal and Dracula's acceptance of his daughter's choice.

name: Hotel Transylvania 2 (2015)
teaser: Mavis and Johnny's son Dennis may or may not be a vampire — and Dracula tries to draw out his fangs. The film's grandpa-vampire comedy expanded the monster universe.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Dennis' fifth birthday and the question of his vampire heritage. Then watch the finale: Dennis reveals his powers during the 'zombie apocalypse' scare.

name: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation (2018)
teaser: The monsters take a luxury cruise — straight into the hands of a vampire-hunting descendant of Abraham Van Helsing. The film's cruise setting was a first for the series.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the monsters' chaotic boarding of the cruise ship. Then watch the finale: Dracula's showdown with Van Helsing aboard the sinking ship.

name: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania (2022)
teaser: A transformation ray turns the monsters human and Johnny into a monster. The film was released directly to streaming due to the pandemic.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the ray's invention and the accidental transformation of everyone. Then watch the finale: the monsters' return to normal in the Amazonian jungle.

name: Surf's Up (2007)
teaser: A mockumentary about a surfing penguin named Cody Maverick chasing the championship. The film was shot like a sports documentary, complete with shaky-cam and interviews.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the 'documentary' style introduces Cody's hometown and his surfing hero Big Z. Then watch the finale: Cody's ride on the legendary wave, honoring Big Z's legacy.

name: Open Season (2006)
teaser: A domesticated grizzly bear and a deer must survive the woods when hunting season opens. The film was Sony Animation's first feature.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Boog's life as a tame bear and his accidental release into the wild. Then watch the finale: Boog and Elliot's stand against the hunters at the dam.

name: Open Season 2 (2008)
teaser: Mr. Weenie is dognapped, and Boog and Elliot must rescue him. The film went direct-to-video but kept the original cast's humor.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Mr. Weenie's 'dognapping' by the pampered pets. Then watch the finale: the rescue mission and Mr. Weenie's choice between his two lives.

name: The Emoji Movie (2017)
teaser: Inside a teenager's phone, a 'meh' emoji goes on a journey to become 'normal.' The film's app-world premise drew record-breaking negative reviews.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the smartphone city of Textopolis and Gene's malfunction. Then watch the finale: Gene's rescue of Jailbreak and his acceptance of his own emoji.

name: The Star (2017)
teaser: The Nativity story told from the animals' point of view — a donkey, a dove and a sheep follow the star to Bethlehem. The film was a surprise holiday hit for Sony.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Bo the donkey's daily grind and his dream of a bigger life. Then watch the finale: the animals' arrival at the stable for the birth of Jesus.

name: Smurfs: The Lost Village (2017)
teaser: A full-CGI Smurfs adventure — Smurfette leads a mission to a forbidden village. The film dropped the live-action format for a fully animated world.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Smurfette's identity crisis and her meeting with Hefty, Brainy and Clumsy. Then watch the finale: the reveal of the all-female Smurf village and Gargamel's defeat.

name: Wish Dragon (2021)
teaser: A modern retelling of Aladdin set in Shanghai — a teenager finds a wish-granting dragon. The film was a China-U.S. co-production released on Netflix.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Din's reunion with his childhood friend Li Na, now a star. Then watch the finale: the wish that matters — friendship over fortune.

name: Vivo (2021)
teaser: A kinkajou with a talent for music journeys from Havana to Miami to deliver a love song. Lin-Manuel Miranda wrote the songs and voiced the title character.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Vivo's Havana routine with his owner Andrés. Then watch the finale: Vivo's rooftop delivery of the song and his new life in Miami.

name: The Angry Birds Movie (2016)
teaser: The phone-game birds get a movie — Red, Chuck and Bomb uncover a pig conspiracy. The film's voice cast starred Jason Sudeikis and Josh Gad.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Red's anger-management classes and his isolation on the island. Then watch the finale: the birds' assault on Piggy Island and the egg rescue.

name: The Angry Birds Movie 2 (2019)
teaser: The birds and pigs must team up to stop a third island's eagle attacks. The film's 'unlikely allies' plot expanded the franchise's world.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the eagle Zeta's plan to freeze the islands. Then watch the finale: the joint bird-pig mission to stop Zeta's ice cannon.

name: DC League of Super-Pets (2022)
teaser: Superman's dog Krypto teams with a shelter mutt to save the Justice League from Lex Luthor. The film was the first theatrical DC film centered on pets.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Krypto's 'Lasso of Truth' park sequence and his bond with Superman. Then watch the finale: the shelter pets' rescue of the Justice League with their new powers.

name: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018)
teaser: The Titans chase superhero movie fame — with meta-jokes at Marvel and DC's expense. The film was praised for its skewering of superhero cinema.

exploreAction.targetName: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Titans' attempts to be 'taken seriously' like other heroes. Then watch the finale: the Titans' refusal of Slade's offer and their true hero moment.

name: Scoob! (2020)
teaser: The origin story of Mystery Inc. — Scooby and Shaggy team with Blue Falcon to stop Dick Dastardly. The film rebooted the franchise for a new era.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — young Scooby and Shaggy's meeting and the formation of Mystery Inc. Then watch the finale: Scooby's choice of friendship over the Falcon Fury jet.

name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water (2015)
teaser: SpongeBob and friends must travel to the surface to save Bikini Bottom from a burger-pirate. The film's live-action/animated hybrid climax was its signature sequence.

exploreAction.targetName: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water (2015) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the 'universe destruction' prologue with Burger Beard and the book. Then watch the finale: the superhero beach fight and the restoration of Bikini Bottom.

name: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run (2020)
teaser: SpongeBob hunts for his lost snail Gary across the ocean — with a visit to the Old West and a surprise appearance by Keanu Reeves. The film's pandemic-era release went straight to streaming in many markets.

exploreAction.targetName: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run (2020) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the posse of SpongeBob, Patrick and the sea-bugs in the Old West. Then watch the finale: SpongeBob's reunion with Gary and the song tribute.

name: PAW Patrol: The Movie (2021)
teaser: The pups head to Adventure City to stop Mayor Humdinger's schemes. The film was Nickelodeon's first big-screen PAW Patrol adventure.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the pups' mission in Adventure City and Chase's fear of the city. Then watch the finale: Chase overcomes his fear to save the city's people.

name: PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie (2023)
teaser: The pups gain superpowers from a meteorite and face the villainous Victoria Vance. The sequel expanded the pup universe with new power suits.

exploreAction.targetName: PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie (2023) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the meteor shower that grants the pups their powers. Then watch the finale: the pups' super-powered rescue of Adventure City.

name: Arthur Christmas (2011)
teaser: Santa's clumsy son Arthur must deliver one forgotten present before dawn. The film's behind-the-scenes look at Santa's high-tech operation was the cleverest Christmas concept in years.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Santa's mission control, a full NORAD-style operation. Then watch the finale: Arthur's 'Grand Santa' moment delivering the gift on the sleigh bike.

name: The Pirates! Band of Misfits (2012)
teaser: A pirate captain seeks the Pirate of the Year award — but his crew is terrible at pirating. The film was Aardman's first in 3D stop-motion, with Hugh Grant as the captain.

exploreAction.targetName: The Pirates! Band of Misfits (2012) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the pirates' disastrous 'raid' that only steals a ham. Then watch the finale: the queen's true identity revealed and the pirates' choice of friendship.

name: Shaun the Sheep Movie (2015)
teaser: Shaun's prank sends the farmer to the city, and the flock must bring him home. The film had no real dialogue — pure physical comedy in the Wallace & Gromit tradition.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Shaun's 'day off' plan that accidentally sends the farmer away. Then watch the finale: the flock's chaotic rescue of the farmer from the city barber.

name: Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon (2019)
teaser: A friendly alien crash-lands near the farm, and Shaun must help it get home. The film's sci-fi parody was packed with 80s movie references.

exploreAction.targetName: Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon (2019) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the alien 'Lu-La' crash-landing and the flock's discovery. Then watch the finale: Shaun's rescue of Lu-La from the secret agents and the UFO send-off.

name: Early Man (2018)
teaser: A stone-age caveman challenges the Bronze Age city to a football match — the first football movie in stop-motion. Nick Park's prehistoric comedy had a British football culture heart.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Dug's tribe's 'hunting' of rabbits with rocks, comedy of errors. Then watch the finale: the football match against the Bronze Age team.

name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget (2023)
teaser: The hens are free, but a new threat — a fast-food chain — forces them to plan another escape. The sequel came 23 years after the original, with Aardman's same stop-motion craft.

exploreAction.targetName: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget (2023) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the free-roaming hen island and Ginger and Rocky's daughter Molly. Then watch the finale: the hens' infiltration of Fun-Land Farms to save Molly.

name: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl (2024)
teaser: Wallace builds a 'smart' gnome that goes rogue and teams with Feathers McGraw for revenge. The film was the franchise's first feature in 19 years, and won the BAFTA for Best Animated Film.

exploreAction.targetName: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl (2024) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Norbot the smart gnome's automated gardening gone wrong. Then watch the finale: Gromit's boat chase with Feathers McGraw on the canal.

name: Coraline (2009)
teaser: A girl finds a parallel world through a small door — with 'other' parents who want to keep her forever. The stop-motion feature, based on Neil Gaiman's novel, was the first in true 3D stop-motion.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the button-eyed 'other world' reveal, a masterclass in unsettling beauty. Then watch the finale: Coraline's escape from the other mother and the button-eyed trap.

name: ParaNorman (2012)
teaser: A boy who sees ghosts must stop a centuries-old witch's curse on his town. The film was praised for its horror-comedy blend and its LGBTQ+ representation.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Norman's ghost-sighting morning routine and his school troubles. Then watch the finale: Norman's confrontation with the witch and the town's apology.

name: The Boxtrolls (2014)
teaser: A boy raised by underground box-dwelling creatures must save them from extermination. The film adapted Alan Snow's novel with Laika's signature craft.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Boxtrolls' underground world and Eggs' upbringing among them. Then watch the finale: Eggs' stand against Archibald Snatcher and the truce above ground.

name: Missing Link (2019)
teaser: A Victorian explorer discovers a lonely Sasquatch and takes him on a world tour to find his cousins. The film won the Golden Globe for Best Animated Feature.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Mr. Link's letter to explorer Sir Lionel Frost. Then watch the finale: the Yeti society's rejection and Mr. Link's choice of family.

name: The Nightmare Before Christmas (1993)
teaser: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town and tries to take over the holiday. Tim Burton's story and Danny Elfman's songs made it a permanent seasonal classic.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — 'This Is Halloween' introduces the town with its gothic whimsy. Then watch the finale: Jack's Christmas rescue and the two holidays' reconciliation.

name: James and the Giant Peach (1996)
teaser: An orphan boy's giant peach rolls across the ocean with an insect crew. The film mixed stop-motion with live-action, based on Roald Dahl's novel.

exploreAction.targetName: James and the Giant Peach (1996) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the live-action world of James' aunts, then the stop-motion peach's launch. Then watch the finale: the peach's landing on the Empire State Building.

name: Corpse Bride (2005)
teaser: A nervous groom accidentally marries a dead bride in the land of the dead. The film's Land of the Dead was rendered in vivid color against the gray living world.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Victor's disastrous wedding rehearsal and his walk through the woods. Then watch the finale: the Corpse Bride's choice to let Victor go, and her release as butterflies.

name: Frankenweenie (2012)
teaser: A boy brings his dog back to life with lightning — and the town's pets follow suit. The black-and-white stop-motion film was Burton's remake of his own 1984 short.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Sparky's death and Victor's science-fair resurrection. Then watch the finale: the pet-monster rampage and Victor's acceptance of letting Sparky go.

name: Fantastic Mr. Fox (2009)
teaser: A fox's chicken-thieving habit endangers the whole animal community. Wes Anderson's stop-motion debut used real fur and hand-made sets, with his signature symmetry.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the couple's fox-trapping montage and the 'wild animal' compromise. Then watch the finale: the animals' heist of the supermarket and the wolf salute.

name: Isle of Dogs (2018)
teaser: In a dystopian Japan, a boy searches for his exiled dog on Trash Island. The stop-motion film's 35mm visual texture won acclaim for its craft.

teaser: The origin of Blossom, Bubbles and Buttercup — created in a lab to fight crime. The film expanded the TV series' world.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Professor Utonium's creation of the girls and Mojo Jojo's scheme. Then watch the finale: the girls' defeat of Mojo and their acceptance by the city.

name: We Bare Bears: The Movie (2020)
teaser: Concluding the Cartoon Network series that ran from 2015 to 2019, this 2020 film follows Grizzly, Panda, and Ice Bear as they must race to Canada after Grizzly's social media mishap attracts unwanted attention. The movie preserves the show's warm, gentle humor while expanding the bears' world with bigger set pieces and emotional resolution.

exploreAction.targetName: We Bare Bears: The Movie (2020) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Grizz's viral video and the bears' nationwide fame. Then watch the finale: the bears' reunion and their acceptance of their place.

name: Steven Universe: The Movie (2019)
teaser: A new villain threatens to undo everything Steven has built — a musical feature-length continuation. The film's songs were written by Rebecca Sugar.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Steven's peaceful life and Spinel's arrival. Then watch the finale: Steven's use of empathy to heal Spinel.

name: Ben 10: Secret of the Omnitrix (2007)
teaser: Ben, Gwen and Kevin search for the Omnitrix's creator before it destroys itself. The film was set between seasons of the original series.

exploreAction.targetName: Ben 10: Secret of the Omnitrix (2007) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Omnitrix's malfunction and the trio's search. Then watch the finale: the Omnitrix's reboot and the planet's salvation.

name: Regular Show: The Movie (2015)
teaser: Mordecai and Rigby travel to the future to stop their older selves. The film concluded the Cartoon Network series' story.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the future's destruction and the time-travel mission. Then watch the finale: the pair's stand against the future villain.

name: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie (2004)
teaser: The first SpongeBob theatrical film, released in November 2004, was intended by series creator Stephen Hillenburg to serve as the series finale — he wanted the show to end after the movie. SpongeBob and Patrick must retrieve King Neptune's crown from Shell City, embarking on an epic road trip that tested the limits of their friendship and Hillenburg's storytelling ambition.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the Krusty Krab promotion and the crown's theft. Then watch the finale: SpongeBob's 'Goofy Goober' rock and the town's rescue.

name: Hey Arnold!: The Movie (2002)
teaser: Arnold and his friends must save their neighborhood from a developer's plan. The film adapted the series' beloved characters to the big screen.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the neighborhood's proposed demolition and the kids' mission. Then watch the finale: the kids' foil of the developer and the neighborhood saved.

name: Doraemon: Nobita's Dinosaur (1980)
teaser: The beloved robot cat's first feature — Nobita's dinosaur egg adventure. The film was the first in the long-running Doraemon movie series.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Nobita's discovery of the egg and the pet dinosaur's growth. Then watch the finale: the return of the dinosaur to its own time.

name: Yellow Submarine (1968)
teaser: The Beatles travel to Pepperland in a psychedelic sea voyage to defeat the Blue Meanies. The film's surreal pop-art animation made it a landmark of 60s cinema.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Pepperland's musical takeover and the Beatles' submarine journey. Then watch the finale: the Beatles' concert that defeats the Blue Meanies with love.

name: The Nutcracker Prince (1990)
teaser: The Christmas classic of Clara and her nutcracker prince — animated by Canada's Lacewood Productions. The film's 'Land of Sweets' finale is its centerpiece.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Clara's Christmas party and the nutcracker's gift. Then watch the finale: the battle with the Mouse King and the journey to the Land of Sweets.

name: Animal Farm (1954)
teaser: The first British animated feature — Orwell's fable of the farm animals' revolution. The film softened Orwell's ending but kept the satire's bite.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Old Major's speech and the animals' rebellion. Then watch the finale: the pigs' betrayal of the revolution and the farm's new tyranny.

name: When the Wind Blows (1986)
teaser: An elderly couple prepares for nuclear war with charming naivety — based on Raymond Briggs' graphic novel. The film's slow dread is unforgettable.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the couple's cheerful preparations with the government leaflets. Then watch the finale: the couple's quiet, devastating acceptance of the end.

name: Waltz with Bashir (2008)
teaser: An Israeli veteran's search for his lost memories of the 1982 Lebanon War, told through interviews. The documentary was the first animated film nominated for a Foreign Language Oscar.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the recurring dream of the sea and the friend's question about the past. Then watch the finale: the real footage of the Sabra and Shatila aftermath.

name: Sita Sings the Blues (2008)
teaser: The Ramayana retold with a modern breakup story woven through — set to 1920s jazz recordings. The film blended every animation technique, from watercolor to shadow puppets.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the three narrators' conflicting versions of the Ramayana. Then watch the finale: Sita's trial by fire and Nina's own story's resolution.

name: Tower (2016)
teaser: A rotoscope documentary of the 1966 UT Tower shooting, told through the survivors' voices. The film's animation let it handle a traumatic day with care.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the August morning routine in Austin and the first shots. Then watch the finale: the police's cornering of the shooter and the survivors' accounts.

name: Flee (2021)
teaser: An Afghan refugee's story, told through animation to protect his identity. The film was the first to be nominated for Best Documentary, Best International Feature and Best Animated Feature at the Oscars.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Amin's present-day life and his decision to finally tell his story. Then watch the finale: Amin's journey's end and the flight's legacy.

name: The Wolf House (2018)
teaser: A girl takes refuge in a house where the walls shift and morph — a Chilean stop-motion horror. The film was made with stop-motion in a single room over five years.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Maria's entry into the house and the wolf's pursuit. Then watch the finale: the house's transformation and the story's dark revelation.

name: Bombay Rose (2019)
teaser: Three intertwined love stories in Mumbai, told in hand-painted animation. The film was the first Indian animated feature to premiere at Venice.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the flower girl's life in the Mumbai streets and the dancer's dreams. Then watch the finale: the three stories' emotional resolutions.

name: The Adventures of Prince Achmed (1926)
teaser: The oldest surviving animated feature — a silhouette animation of the Arabian Nights. Lotte Reiniger created the film with her cut-paper technique and hand-tinted color.

exploreAction.targetName: The Adventures of Prince Achmed (1926) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the sorcerer's magic horse and Prince Achmed's kidnapping. Then watch the finale: Achmed's rescue of the princess and the sorcerer's defeat.

name: The Tale of the Fox (1937)
teaser: The first feature-length puppet animation — a fox's trial for his misdeeds. The film took Starevich nearly a decade to complete.

exploreAction.targetName: The Tale of the Fox (1937) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the fox's sly misdeeds against the other animals. Then watch the finale: the fox's trial and his clever escape from punishment.

name: Father Christmas (1991)
teaser: Raymond Briggs' grumpy Santa takes a summer holiday and world tour. The British TV special adapted the beloved picture book.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Father Christmas' grumpy post-Christmas routine. Then watch the finale: his world tour and his happy return to Christmas work.

name: The Snowman (1982)
teaser: A boy's snowman comes to life and takes him on a flight to the North Pole. The wordless TV special with 'Walking in the Air' became a Christmas institution.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the boy's building of the snowman and his midnight awakening. Then watch the finale: the flight to the North Pole and the snowman's melting farewell.

name: Kirikou and the Wild Beasts (2005)
teaser: A prequel to Kirikou and the Sorceress, told in vignettes of the tiny hero's cleverness. The film was drawn by a team of young African animators.

exploreAction.targetName: Kirikou and the Wild Beasts (2005) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Kirikou's village life and the new threats to the harvest. Then watch the finale: Kirikou's clever solutions to each of the wild beasts.

name: Princes and Princesses (2000)
teaser: Six fairy tales told in silhouette animation — a boy and girl invent stories each night. The film's shadow-puppet style was Ocelot's signature.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the two storytellers in their theater and the first tale. Then watch the finale: the lovers' tales and the storytelling's magic.

name: Dilili in Paris (2018)
teaser: A young girl from New Caledonia investigates kidnappings in Belle Époque Paris. The film was built around photographs of real 1900 Paris locations.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — Dilili's arrival in Paris and the missing girls' mystery. Then watch the finale: Dilili's unmasking of the Male Masters and the girls' rescue.

name: My Love (2006)
teaser: A 19th-century Russian student's impossible love, painted frame by frame on glass. Petrov's oil-on-glass technique won the film the Grand Prix at Annecy.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the student's lovesick yearning and the painterly world. Then watch the finale: the love triangle's resolution and the snow-covered end.

name: The Old Man and the Sea (1999)
teaser: Hemingway's novella painted entirely on glass — Petrov's masterpiece won the Oscar for Best Animated Short. Each frame was painted by hand on glass panes.

exploreAction.targetName: The Old Man and the Sea (1999) end-to-end
exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the old fisherman's struggle with the marlin, painted in flowing oils. Then watch the finale: the shark's taking of the catch and the old man's return.

name: The Scarecrow (2000)
teaser: A scarecrow's journey to find a heart, set to original music. The New Zealand short won the Grand Prix at Annecy.

exploreAction.instruction: Watch the opening — the scarecrow's awakening and his quest across the farm. Then watch the finale: his reunion with the crow and his quiet happiness.
